title: hieracium × variifurcum
intro: Hieracium × variifurcum, commonly known as a hybrid hawkweed, is a plant that belongs to the dandelion family (Asteraceae) and is characterized by its unique leaf and flower morphology. The health benefits associated with Hieracium × variifurcum include its potential to support digestive health, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which can help to modulate the immune system and alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium × variifurcum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
